title: Fix auditor defects found by TAX-055
scope: Fix the two open auditor-app defects recorded in docs/evidence/TAX-055/README.md: field-error colour contrast and the wrong disabled-suggestion reason on resolved cases

acceptance.text: Auditor field errors meet 4.5:1 contrast (e.g. the reject-reason error, currently #e03434 on white = 4.45:1) and the KNOWN_A11Y_ISSUES entry for it is removed
On a resolved case the disabled 'Use as a starting point' explains that the case is resolved, not that a decision is waiting; tests assert both fixes and the auditor e2e and TAX-055 suites pass
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: On a resolved case the disabled 'Use as a starting point' explains that the case is resolved, not that a decision is waiting; tests assert both fixes and the auditor e2e and TAX-055 suites pass

evidence.text: apps/auditor-web/src/style.css sets #app [data-slot='error'] to var(--ink-red-8). Measured in Edge with axe color-contrast: #941f1f on #ffffff = 8.48:1 for the SYN-005 reject-reason error at 1440/1024/390, the propose rationale error, the evidence-request message error and the three showcase errors (8.1:1 on the #f8fafc canvas; before the fix #e03434 = 4.26:1 there). Custom text-ink-red-7 errors measure 6.4:1. KNOWN_A11Y_ISSUES entry for #reject-reason-error removed from tests/frontend/support/checks.ts; new smoke.spec.ts contrast test fails without the rule and passes with it. Screens: docs/evidence/TAX-104/field-error-*.png.

DecisionPanel passes the reason to SuggestionList: 'This case is resolved.' on a resolved case, 'Another decision on this case is waiting for approval.' while one is open. Asserted by two new DecisionPanel.test.ts unit tests, review.spec.ts (case 1 after approval) and scenarios.spec.ts SYN-001 after approval. npm run check pass (auditor 113 unit tests, taxpayer 72); auditor e2e (Edge) 66 passed, 17 skipped; TAX-055 scenarios 21 passed (--workers=2); whole tests/frontend 195 passed, 9 skipped (--workers=2). Screens: docs/evidence/TAX-104/resolved-suggestion-*.png, waiting-suggestion-1440.png.

Evidence and screenshots (Edge, 1440/1024/390) in docs/evidence/TAX-104/README.md; local check results recorded in the task and in PR #254 because hosted CI is unavailable; task set IN_REVIEW with PR #254; Kellybrackets (Keletso) requested as reviewer.

notes.text: Added 2026-11-05: two product defects TAX-055 recorded for the auditor owner had no task.

PR #254 opened: field errors now #941f1f (8.48:1 on white), KNOWN_A11Y_ISSUES entry removed, resolved cases explain the disabled suggestion. Local checks pass (npm run check, auditor e2e 66 passed, tests/frontend 195 passed with --workers=2, validate.py); mypy not run locally.
